notes: Day mode is actually light now. It never was: day was #0A0C0F and night #06080A, two near-blacks four points apart, so picking Day changed nothing you could see. Day is now a real light theme - light grey field, white cards, near-black text, and the ice blue taken down to a teal that can be read on white. Night is untouched. Set it in Settings > Display > Theme; Auto still follows your headlights, falling back to the clock. Every colour was picked against the contrast thresholds rather than by eye, and the test that would have caught the old fake day mode is now in the build.
